_comment: F01 lifecycle per-phase claim map -- the registration the written-bar assessment named as its gap. Facts derived from pinned artifacts; judgments authored. Regenerate: tools/phase4_f01_lifecycle_claim_map.py
subject: scene-transition request machinery (0x800823A0, region dispatch, finalizer)
axis: cold boot / load / first use / repeated use / exhaustion / retirement / reuse (mechanics_baseline.yaml section G)

cold_boot.claim: the machinery is exercised from genuine cold boot, twice, with nothing injected: one natural completion (request 1 -> finalizer) and one natural death (request 2 -> skip)
cold_boot.fact: oracle all_passed=True, death control DONE; both from-boot with pre-load noise rejected by instruction self-certification

load.claim: load-time construction of the machinery's state is pinned: the converter builds the sector/region table at scene load and the request cell's load-time value is observed as 0
load.fact: static census via tools/phase4_f01_objective_lifecycle.c; disc-side census 16/16 scenes, 0 disagreements

first_use.claim: the first transition decision of every level obeys the branch law
first_use.fact: 19/19 levels, first decision asserted on each, 0 law failures

repeated_use.claim: multiple decisions within one level obey the law, including mixed call/skip sequences
repeated_use.fact: 35 decisions total; up to 5 in one level (LEVEL07: 1 call + 4 skips)

exhaustion.claim: the request word is a scalar latch, not a pool; its saturated state IS the single-shot guard ([0x800823A0] != 0 suppresses every further region trigger in the scene)
exhaustion.fact: guard pinned statically (re-read at 0x8004965C, bnez 0x80049664); exactly one exit decision per completed level across 19 replays is the guard operating

retirement.claim: the cell is cleared (retired to 0) after consumption, by a small observed writer set, on every level -- attributed to EXACT store instructions, with the write-watch +4 reporting convention disclosed
retirement.fact: reported value-0 writer PCs ['0x80036b90', '0x80036cd0', '0x80036d0c', '0x8004fe48', '0x8005b88c'] observed on 19/19 levels; each reported pc is the true store +4 (compiled-C verified, convention_holds_at_every_row=True). Instruction-exact: two mechanisms -- shell clears via `sh zero,0x23a0(at)` at 0x8004FE44/0x8005B888 (direct), and the movement integrator's 16-bit clear split into byte pairs `sb zero,0/1(s6)` at 0x80036B8C/0x80036CCC/0x80036D08 (register-base; the watch itself proved each write landed on the cell)

reuse.claim: the cell is reused after each retirement: successive set->consume->clear cycles within one session, plus the full birth-to-retirement arc from BIOS in a single from-boot run
reuse.fact: up to 5 successive request cycles in one LEVEL07 session (4 skips then the exit call); the from-boot death session's access log shows the whole arc -- BIOS init (fr 98), EXE-init clear (0x8005F6A0, fr 1141), shell clear (0x8004FADC), level-entry clears (0x8005B888/0x8004FE44, fr 5724-5725), certified death store 2 (0x8004A8B4, fr 6536), consumer clear one frame after the decision (0x8004FE44, fr 6656)
reuse.residual_note: a cross-LEVEL chain (level->results->next-level) in one armed session remains unobserved, but that belongs to the scene+overlay TRANSITIONS axis, not to this cell's reuse; recorded here so it is not lost. ⚠️ It CANNOT be closed by arming a go_to_end movie -- those are CachedInterpreter recordings and desync silently under any CPU hook; it needs an Interpreter recording or poll-only observation

summary: 6 covered, 1 n/a-with-reason, 0 partial of 7 phases. Remaining gap is ONE claim: a multi-level chain with watches armed.
